title: A participant's copy of the header a background run hands its result back under, behind a square or fullwidth bracket, reaches the model with its opening replaced; the header the runtime writes over a delegation's result reaches the notified agent as written, a copy in the worker's output replaced as the runtime writes the hand-back, and as the agent's next turn replays it, and the same words in prose or behind a round bracket are kept; a caller's deliver() naming the runtime record in its metadata gets no provenance, its copy replaced
notes: RMK-645: the runtime writes a header over each result it hands back (Python orchestration/strategies/supervisor/_inject_per_worker.py, supervisor/delegate.py, core/mixins/delegation.py, orchestration/strategies/loop.py, orchestration/_background.py; roomkit-rs kit/tasks.rs, orchestration/strategies/supervisor/team.rs and per_worker.rs, orchestration/background.rs) that RFC §6.4 did not list among the marks: a participant's copy was kept. One room per message, so each generation reads one message; the delegation hands its result back to the same agent last. The hand-back carries the runtime's provenance (runtime_record "handback"), set by the runtime only: the reader keeps its header, and a copy of a mark a model wrote into it (the task, the worker's output) is replaced as it is written. The agent's next turn replays the hand-back it read, its header kept by the provenance its instruction_read row carries. The last step delivers an instruction whose metadata names runtime_record: the record is the runtime's alone, so the copy is replaced.
